Bing Webmaster Tools API fixtures (Phase 12 C3), in the JSON shape of Microsoft's documented samples
(IWebmasterApi.GetUserSites / GetRankAndTrafficStats / GetQueryStats / GetPageStats / GetCrawlStats /
GetCrawlIssues: `{ "d": [...] }`, `__type`, `/Date(ms-0700)/` dates, CrawlIssues as a flag number).
